entities.summary: Patryk Dominik Sztyber (b. 1979-08-04, Opoczno) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Opoczno and Poland. Known in the fields of poland, composers & musicians, europe.
